$comment: Architect -> driver. Written to .pipeline/slice.json on STEP=next-slice.

status.$comment: ready = slice.md is written and the pipeline may proceed; blocked = a human decision is required, see `blocked_on`; done = the queue in docs/architecture/plan.md is empty.

id.$comment: Slice id in the project's own scheme, e.g. E4 or R5b. Becomes the `Slice:` commit trailer.

revision.$comment: Starts at 1; incremented every time the architect rewrites slice.md after reviewer questions.

touches.$comment: Paths the slice is expected to change. Advisory: the reviewer flags work outside it rather than the driver blocking it.

needs_godot_tests.$comment: True when the slice touches runtime code, so `make godot-test` is part of acceptance rather than just `make lint`.

blocked_on.$comment: Questions only the human can answer. Required in practice when status=blocked.
